answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, and therefore paying the meadow bond on all of them and exposing each to the canyon slash. Because the grove audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 5 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. A farm of 104 pays that 147 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
